title: Club Ecosystems
hook: Internal tools that give club members their time back.
text: I have built a handful of applications, not to boast about what I have made, but because I believe technology should make people's lives easier. I build to improve efficiency within the club, reduce unnecessary work, and give students more room to simply be students — while still making it easier for everyone to get the job done.
highlights: Several applications built for the club's day-to-day operations.
Focused on removing repetitive admin work.
Designed to leave students with more room to be students.

caseStudy.problem: Club operations depended on repeated manual work that took time away from the actual reason students joined.
caseStudy.approach: I built a set of small applications around the tasks that repeated most, each one replacing a manual step rather than adding another tool to maintain.
caseStudy.outcome: The tools are in use across the club, and the portfolio of systems keeps growing as new bottlenecks appear.
caseStudy.learned: Internal tools are judged differently: nobody praises them, they just stop complaining. That is the point.
